q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We will email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes. Let us know if you need further assistance!

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan is $4 per month and includes unlimited notes and support for 3 devices. You can save 20% with annual billing. More information about all plans is available in the FAQ.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: Team is $8 per user per month, so for 5 people it would be $40 per month. Annual billing saves 20%.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: The Free plan allows up to 100 notes and supports 1 device. Plus is $4/month for unlimited notes and 3 devices, and Team is $8/user/month with shared workspaces. Annual billing saves 20% on both Plus and Team plans.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Plus and Team subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Please contact support with your order number to request a refund. You can reach support at support@example.com.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: Plus and Team subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Unfortunately, as you purchased the plan three weeks ago, a refund is not possible. Please contact support with your order number if you have further questions.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: There is no Linux desktop app, but Linux users can use the web app. It is supported on any modern web browser. You can find more information in our FAQ.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: Android 12 or later is supported. Unfortunately, Android 11 is not listed as a supported platform. I can open a support ticket if you’d like.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: No, the web app needs a connection to work. The mobile and desktop apps do work offline and sync when you reconnect. Please let me know if you have other questions about Example Notes.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to Settings > Export. You can export all notes as Markdown or PDF. Exports are emailed as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore" to get it back. I hope this helps!

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: No, we only support authenticator apps for two-factor authentication. You can enable this in Settings > Security > Two-factor authentication. I hope this helps!

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: 25 MB per file on Free. Plus and Team plans allow 250 MB per file. I hope this answers your question!

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No, you keep paid features until the end of the current billing period. You can cancel your plan in Settings > Billing > Cancel plan.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your data is stored in AWS data centers in the United States, encrypted at rest and in transit. Please let me know if you have any other questions about Example Notes.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We reply to emails sent to support@example.com within one business day. Please reach out to that address if you need further assistance. I hope this helps!

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, annual billing saves 20% on Plus and Team plans. You can find more details about our plans in the FAQ.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: With the Plus plan, you can use Example Notes on up to 3 devices. It costs $4 per month and also includes unlimited notes. Annual billing saves 20%.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: I don't know. Please contact support@example.com and they will reply within one business day.

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: I don't know. Please contact support@example.com to open a support ticket.

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: I don’t know. However, I can open a support ticket for you if you'd like.

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: I don't know. There is no Linux desktop app currently, but the web app is available for Linux users. If you’d like, I can open a support ticket for you.
